title: Speaking Fluency And Coherence
content: Fluency and Coherence measure how smoothly and logically you speak. Good answers continue without long pauses and organize ideas clearly. A common mistake is memorizing answers and then sounding unnatural when the question changes.

title: Speaking Lexical Resource
content: Lexical Resource in Speaking means using enough vocabulary to discuss familiar and less familiar topics. The goal is precision, not rare words. A useful habit is to explain unknown words with paraphrase instead of stopping.

title: Grammar And Pronunciation
content: Grammar is judged by range and accuracy in spoken sentences. Pronunciation is judged by clarity, stress, rhythm, and how easy you are to understand. A common mistake is speaking too fast, which can reduce clarity even if grammar is good.
